title: Macerich Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Macerich's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
SANTA MONICA, Calif., July 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --


**WHAT** : Macerich (NYSE: MAC) Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


**WHEN** : Earnings Results will be released after market on Tuesday, August 4, 2026. Management will hold a conference call at 2:00 pm Pacific Time (5:00 pm Eastern Time) on that same day to discuss quarterly results.


**PARTICIPANT DIAL-IN INFORMATION** : The conference call can be accessed live by dialing the following numbers:


United States (Toll Free): +1 833-630-1956
International: +1 412-317-1837


**PARTICIPANT LIVE WEBCAST** :[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/8mumave2](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WcgZ35vIt294gBdGBlvqathrX7_rMuwmbZ1nKNILjiOfRyIGy06-I2NlJdfm2t2VtBTQ-Kl0iSYP0NTxqW5qYvpzlWCJPxowSEP4-9E1jEhiz8CNz_-24ZSqk2lQmXVGJEKOrhEN2i04Kg3C3s8F9o_NSbTR0XDIyPFGlm_g5M0=)


**REBROADCAST** : Following the live webcast, a replay will be available in the Investors Section of the Company’s website at[https://investing.macerich.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WcgZ35vIt294gBdGBlvqavZYoCs8zrdVVKUDLcHjnLxtEm3cJ2yAsEr6RZy1wrYli0rlf-BEP6N8bOTWWVkkjJKB1qr6TomovZxbNnzTLtS0uYmUseuH_gnKpJU_EwhJ) .


**About Macerich**


Macerich (NYSE: MAC) is a fully integrated, self-managed, self-administered real estate investment trust (REIT). As a leading owner, operator, and developer of high-quality retail real estate in densely populated and attractive U.S. markets, Macerich’s portfolio is concentrated in California, the Pacific Northwest, Phoenix/Scottsdale, and the Metro New York to Washington, D.C. corridor. Developing and managing properties that serve as community cornerstones, Macerich currently owns approximately 41 million square feet of real estate, consisting primarily of interests in 39 retail centers.


Macerich uses, and intends to continue to use, its Investor Relations website, which can be found at investing.macerich.com, as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Additional information about Macerich can be found through social media platforms such as LinkedIn. Reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures, including NOI and FFO, to the most directly comparable GAAP measures are included in the earnings release and supplemental filed on Form 8-K with the SEC, which are posted on the Investor Relations website at[investing.macerich.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zKxiONL5rjsJPxkLSad7VOXMXdwaupPg1lhQuLBJi2bMLUh5hHTKGWtiiiQ6rgO6PzYMd2JOZbngDi-6HK11E6_Pklljrx_piCcE4Pllxz8DzKEHU94RJ8OWIqZQBuJRn-XuJiQY2OCDNDS9KipXzspgDDLm4Tb7z2wJ6lPd4E3dvpAeaAQw9iYjc2Ri5NJJd8KwFDu-E0wkoyaNg6BSAt4-tVsGGb8jSfLn0Hy5X7wE__b5p0qx02yDV83zuupDMmXIRz-GVz0ERtVNoK-z8g==) .
